messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync  Need to lock down the Trailblazer customer story flow: blog post, short social hero, webinar slot, and a product demo clip. Legal wants written approval + metric provenance before we publish. Can we list owners?
Gabi Rivera: I can own the customer liaison and quote approvals. Will request a signed release. Do we have a firm webinar date?
Maya Chen: Targeting 2026-04-15 for the webinar, demo on the same day. If approvals slip, we hold the social push.
Leo Park: They sent interview notes. Pulled three candidate hero lines below. Also uploaded their headshot and logo to the shared drive.
Leo Park: ```
A) "Redwood cut our per-request inference spend and made performance dependable."
B) "35% improvement in inference unit cost after Dedicated with batching + KV cache."
C) "Integration was straightforward; our SLAs improved across the board."
```
Jack O'Neill: Option B is specific  we need Trailblazer to confirm the 35% and sign off on the exact phrasing. Legal also asked for a short methodology blurb (what workload, seq len, config) to live in the appendix.
Ana Morales: CS can provide the benchmark spreadsheet. We ran the "catalog-search" harness (median seq len 64, beam=1) and measured token-unit cost with and without prefix caching. I'll export sanitized numbers for the appendix.
Shane Patel: FYI the 35% number reflects token-cost reduction when batching=auto and KV cache enabled; raw model FLOPS dropped by ~28%. We should present the conservative 35% with a parenthetical note describing the test.
Gabi Rivera: I'll ask them to confirm the number and to approve the hero quote. Also need explicit permission for use in paid channels if we want to boost the launch post.
DesignBot: Mockups ready: 16:9 hero card, one-slide benchmark visual, and a short video thumbnail. Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd-trailblazer-case. Use Trailblazer primary color for the card, center quote, left-aligned logos.
Maya Chen: Copy needs to be short: headline, 1-paragraph summary, CTA to webinar signup. Leo can you draft the blog opener and tweet thread?
Leo Park: Draft blog opener + tweets: 
```
Blog opener: We partnered with Trailblazer to make product search faster and cheaper. In our benchmark, they saw a 35% drop in per-request token cost and more stable p99 latency. Read the case and join the webinar on April 15 for a live demo.
Tweet thread: 1/ We helped Trailblazer speed up search and reduce inference costs.
2/ Result: 35% lower per-request cost (batching + KV cache).
3/ Demo + benchmark on 4/15  Register: https://redwood.ai/events
```
Jack O'Neill: Two legal asks: (1) a short signed release: "Trailblazer consents to use of quotes, logos, and performance metrics for Redwood marketing." (2) a one-paragraph methodology note in the appendix describing workload and measurement approach.
Ana Morales: I'll route the release to their GC this morning. They typically respond within 48 hours but will nudge for faster.
Gabi Rivera: Trailblazer requested the demo clip be under 90s and not show any PII or proprietary prompts. We'll produce a 45s demo focusing on the fast-path results.
Shane Patel: For the webinar slides: single benchmark overview slide + appendix with numbers and the spreadsheet link. Sales asked that we avoid per-customer raw logs; use aggregated metrics and a high-res graph.
Maya Chen: Actions and owners: Gabi  customer approvals + release; Ana  benchmark export; Leo  final hero quote + blog + tweets; Design  social card + slide visuals + video thumbnail; Jack  legal wording and final signoff. Internal review Wed 4/8, final signoff Fri 4/10.
Gabi Rivera: Adding to calendar and will ping them after our stand. Will update this thread when I have the signed release. :thumbsup:
Leo Park: Note from customer: they want the 35% phrasing to include "after enabling batching and KV cache". I'll fold that into the quote candidates.
Jack O'Neill: If we get the release, are we ok to run the paid social campaign the same day as the blog? Legal: paid ads need specific written ad permission; organic posts covered by standard release.
Gabi Rivera: I'll request paid-ad permission in the same email.
Maya Chen: Great. If all signs green, coordinate cross-post: blog + webinar registration + social + sales-ready one-pager. If any hold, we gate social and ads.
DesignBot: Uploaded slide assets and a short ad-safe cut of the demo to the shared folder. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/trailblazer-case-assets
Ana Morales: Uploaded the sanitized benchmark CSV and a short README describing the test harness. Link in the folder.
Shane Patel: Will draft the appendix methodology blurb and drop it here for legal review.
Maya Chen: Thanks team. We'll reconvene in this thread after Gabi posts the signed release.
